editorial:
Imagine being in 6th grade and getting a new substitute teacher who seems perfect to every adult but is a total nightmare to the kids. That is exactly what happens here. You get to follow a group of students who quickly realize their new teacher is not actually human. She is an alien with scary powers, like reading minds, and she uses those powers to manipulate everyone. The movie blends a creepy atmosphere with some funny moments, making it feel like a dark playground story come to life. It captures that frustrating feeling of being a kid when no one believes you, even when the truth is right in front of your face.

The pacing keeps you on your toes, and the tension builds up nicely as the kids try to stop her plan for the Paris competition. While some of the special effects look a bit dated now, the acting makes up for it. It is a great pick if you enjoy movies where kids have to save the day.
endingExplained: In the final act, you find out the teacher is part of an alien invasion plan. She wants to use the kids to help her people take over. The students eventually team up and use their own wits to outsmart her. They manage to expose her true form and stop her from leaving for Paris. The movie wraps up with the kids finally being believed and the scary alien threat being defeated for good.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about kids fighting monsters or mean teachers.
